Why this matters

Move from proof of concept to enterprise deployment with confidence

Successfully moving from a proof of concept to enterprise deployment requires more than building an agent. It requires architecture, governance, security, lifecycle management, and operational practices that support scale. This Bootcamp gives technical teams practical guidance, hands-on experience, and proven implementation patterns informed by Microsoft engineering and customer engagements.

Architecture-first design

Learn the patterns that help teams design secure, scalable, and maintainable Copilot agents.

Hands-on implementation

Apply concepts through guided labs based on realistic enterprise implementation scenarios.

Learn from Microsoft experts

Work with engineering and field specialists who support enterprise Copilot implementations.

Customer implementation insights

Reduce implementation risk through proven architectures, common challenges, and lessons learned.

Who should attend

Designed for technical teams responsible for enterprise delivery

  • ✓Solution and enterprise architects
  • ✓Developers and technical leads
  • ✓Platform administrators and governance owners
  • ✓Security, compliance, and ALM practitioners
  • ✓Customer and partner implementation teams
  • ✓Technical decision-makers planning production adoption

Best suited for active implementation teams

This is an architecture-first technical experience. It is most valuable for participants who are designing, building, governing, or preparing to operationalize Microsoft Copilot agents—not for general product awareness alone.

Three-day agenda

Design. Build. Govern. Scale.

Each day builds toward production readiness, combining architecture guidance, implementation practice, and operational decision-making.

01Day 1 · Design the foundationArchitecture, use-case design, grounding, actions, connectors, and implementation review+
  • Architecture foundations
  • Use-case framing
  • Knowledge and grounding
  • Actions and connectors
  • Implementation review
02Day 2 · Build and integrateBuild agents, integrate with Microsoft Cloud, test, evaluate, and extend capabilities+
  • Environment strategy
  • Enterprise integrations
  • Testing and evaluation
  • Multi-agent patterns
  • Hands-on implementation
03Day 3 · Govern and scaleGovernance, security, ALM, monitoring, adoption, and production readiness+
  • Security and governance
  • ALM and deployment
  • Observability
  • Operational ownership
  • Scaling for production
